InvestigatorProfile.title: InvestigatorProfile
InvestigatorProfile.description: Private investigator account profile storing verified identity metadata and workspace attribution.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Investigator full name or handle displayed on reports and notes.

email.description: Verified investigator email address (PII, owner-read only).

organization.description: Newsroom, forensic lab, or academic institution.

roleTitle.description: Descriptive job title such as Digital Forensics Analyst.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

ForensicCaseRecord.title: ForensicCaseRecord
ForensicCaseRecord.description: Cloud-persisted digital forensic investigation record scoped strictly to its owning investigator.

id.description: Investigation identifier matching the document ID.

title.description: Concise title of the forensic investigation.

investigator.description: Lead investigator name attributed to the case.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the case. Archived is terminal.

summary.description: Contextual summary and scope notes for the investigation.

evidenceCount.description: Number of evidence items linked to this investigation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when case was opened.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when case was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Private investigator profile document strictly isolated to ownerId == request.auth.uid.

/users/{userId}/cases/{caseId}.description: Private cloud-synced forensic case records owned by the authenticated investigator.
